title: Chapter 123: Escape
html:
The fake-bloodstained rag doll arced through the air and struck the shadow. Somehow, the blow stopped the formless thing at the door, with Xiaoxiao clamped onto its arm.

“Well done!” Chen Ge trained his flashlight on it. The shadow writhed beneath the beam, its darkness fading. Outside the mirror, it was weaker than he had expected. It tore away part of its own body and fled into Room 302.

The severed fragment quickly vanished. Chen Ge could not tell whether it had dissolved or Xiaoxiao had devoured it.

Eating these things seems to make Xiaoxiao stronger.Chen Ge tucked her into his pocket and hammered Room 302’s lock with the mallet.

“Come out!” The old steel door shuddered, shedding dust and flakes of rust as its frame shook. The racket awakened the entire floor, and Room 301’s door opened a crack.

“What’s all this noise?” the middle-aged man shouted, beer bottle in hand, though he kept most of his body safely inside. Then Room 302 flew open, and its tenant lunged at Chen Ge with a cleaver.

Did the mirror monster possess him?The narrow corridor left little room to dodge. Spotting Room 301’s open door behind him, Chen Ge threw himself inside and slammed it shut.

The cleaver rang against the steel door. Bloodshot eyes and face twisted with madness, the young man hacked in silence, pouring all his strength into each blow as though determined to carve Chen Ge apart.

The creature’s fury was understandable. After weeks of preparation, it had nearly taken Men Nan’s body only for Chen Ge to stop it at the last moment—and tear away part of it in the process. The cleaver continued crashing against the door.

“What’s happening?” Stunned, the middle-aged man’s knees buckled and he collapsed against the shoe rack.

“Help me!” The room door was not locked, and the young man could have burst through at any moment.

“I—I’ll call the police!” He dared not approach the door. Setting his beer down, he scrambled for his phone and knocked over several empty bottles.

“I said come help me with the door!”

As the blows echoed through the building, lights came on one after another and frightened tenants peered into the corridor.

After laying Men Nan on Room 304’s sofa, Doctor Gao heard Chen Ge shouting for help. He rushed into the corridor with a stool.

Consumed by rage, the young man focused entirely on Chen Ge. Doctor Gao crept up behind him and, from a meter away, swung the stool into his upper back. He had probably aimed for the head, but missed.

The young man staggered into the door. Still gripping the cleaver, he twisted his neck around at an unnatural angle and glared at Doctor Gao with bloodshot eyes.

A growl bubbled from his throat. As he turned toward Doctor Gao, Chen Ge kicked the door open. It slammed into the attacker, and before he could recover, Chen Ge snatched a bottle from the floor and smashed it over his head.

Glass burst and blood streamed down the young man’s face. Chen Ge tackled him to the floor while Doctor Gao wrested away the cleaver.

The young man fought until several tenants joined in to restrain him. At last he stopped resisting. With one cheek pressed to the concrete, he stared at Chen Ge as though committing his face to memory.

Three minutes later, his pupils rolled back and he lost consciousness. At that same instant, his shadow peeled away from the wall and raced down the stairs.

Many people present saw that, but before they could react, the shadow had disappeared into the night.

“What was that?” Doctor Gao’s eyes widened; many strange things had happened that night.

“I’m not sure.” The hatred in the young man’s final stare reminded Chen Ge of the mirror monster in the Haunted House. Did they both come from the same world behind the mirrors?

Chen Ge climbed to his feet and started after it, only to find the landlady blocking the stairs, her face grim.

Did the monster take her too?He backed away several steps, though guilt over the chaos he had caused that night also made him uneasy.

“What are all of you doing at this hour?” The landlady climbed to the third floor with several older tenants behind her. As Chen Ge searched for an explanation, the man from Room 301 finally emerged with his phone.

“Sis, it feels like Brother-in-law has come back,” he whispered. “Xiao Du from 302 attacked people with a cleaver. He behaved exactly the way Brother-in-law did.”

When he said that, the tenants who had gathered around started to disperse. A few ran back into their rooms and locked the door tight.

“Wasn’t everything fine?” The landlady surveyed the wrecked corridor, ordered her brother to take the young man to the hospital, then approached Chen Ge and Doctor Gao.

“We were merely defending ourselves; the kid from Room 302 almost killed me.”

“I know.” After a pause, the landlady spoke bluntly. “I still have apartments to rent. If this grows any more complicated, it will ruin my business. Let’s end it here. I’ll cover the boy’s medical expenses, and we won’t involve the police. He’s still young; I don’t want to destroy his future.”

Her words confirmed that she knew something about Room 303 and the cause of Xiao Du’s madness.

After weighing the consequences, Chen Ge saw no benefit in pressing the matter. The black phone’s mission was already complete. He conferred with Doctor Gao, and both accepted the landlady’s proposal.

Once the landlady left, Doctor Gao returned to Room 304 to watch Men Nan while Chen Ge waited in the living room. He still had many questions for Xiao Du.
